$comment: Kiosk chrome strings. Consumed by apps/kiosk-frontend through the API's
/v1/kiosk/i18n endpoint, so the frontend ships no hardcoded copy (§8).
Voice keys ending in '_spoken' are TTS scripts: longer, conversational, and
read aloud automatically. The matching on-screen key is short, because a
kiosk header at large type has room for very few words (§1).

app.name: MediKiosk
app.tagline: Tell us about your health before you see the doctor

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Touch the screen to begin
welcome.start_spoken: Welcome. Touch the large green button on the screen to begin. If you need help at any time, touch the help button, and a member of staff will come to you.
welcome.free_and_private: This is free, and your information is private

language.title: Choose your language
language.title_spoken: Please choose the language you are most comfortable with. Touch your language on the screen.

department.title: Which department are you visiting?
department.title_spoken: Which department are you visiting today? Touch the one you have come for.
department.fixed_by_device: This kiosk is set up for {department}

identity.title: Let us identify you
identity.title_spoken: First, let us identify you. If you have an ABHA health card, you can scan it. If you do not have one, that is completely fine — we can register you here.
identity.scan_abha_spoken: Hold your ABHA card in front of the camera, with the square code facing the screen.
identity.no_abha: I do not have an ABHA card
identity.no_abha_is_fine: You do not need an ABHA card to be seen today
identity.create_abha: I want to create an ABHA card
identity.create_abha_note: You will be taken to the Government's own ABHA service to create it. We never see or store your Aadhaar number.
identity.phone_last4: Last 4 digits of your phone number
identity.phone_last4_help: We only ask for the last 4 digits, so the hospital can match your record.
identity.existing_record_note: Please check that this is you

consent.title: Your permission
consent.each_separately: You can agree to each one separately
consent.required_note: The first permission is needed to continue. The others are your choice.
consent.declined_body: You have not given permission, so we will not continue here. Please go to the registration counter and a staff member will help you in person.
consent.withdraw_anytime: You can withdraw your permission at any time

caregiver.title: Who is answering the questions?
caregiver.title_spoken: Who will answer the questions? If you are helping the patient, please tell us, so the doctor knows.
caregiver.caregiver_answering: I am answering for the patient
caregiver.patient_ack_spoken: This question is for the patient. Is it all right if this person answers the questions on your behalf? Please answer yourself, by voice or by touching the screen.
caregiver.patient_ack_yes: Yes, they may answer for me
caregiver.patient_cannot_respond: The patient is unable to answer at all
caregiver.staff_required_title: A staff member must help with this
caregiver.staff_required_body: When a patient cannot answer at all, a staff member has to record this with a document. Please go to the counter — we have saved nothing yet.
caregiver.recorded_as: Answers will be marked as reported by {name} ({relationship})

interview.listening_spoken: I am listening. Please speak now.
interview.skip_confirm: Mark this as 'I do not know'?
interview.not_understood_spoken: I am sorry, I did not catch that. Please try again, or answer by touching the screen.
interview.voice_unavailable_title: Voice is not working right now
interview.voice_unavailable_body: Please answer by touching the screen. Nothing you have told us is lost.

escalation.$comment: Shown when a critical red flag fires. Calm, icon-based, never technical, never a diagnosis (§14).
escalation.title: Thank you
escalation.body: A nurse is coming to help you now. Please stay seated.
escalation.body_spoken: Thank you. A nurse is coming to help you right now. Please stay seated and do not worry. You do not need to do anything else.
escalation.waiting_for_nurse: A nurse has been informed and is coming
escalation.few_more_questions: While you wait, just a few short questions
escalation.few_more_questions_spoken: While the nurse is on the way, I will ask just a few short but important questions.
escalation.nurse_acknowledged: A nurse has seen this and is on the way

documents.title: Do you have any medical papers with you?
documents.title_spoken: Do you have any old prescriptions, test reports or hospital papers with you today? Showing them helps the doctor a great deal.
documents.why: Old prescriptions and reports help the doctor understand your history
documents.no_i_dont: No, I do not have any
documents.ask_staff: Ask a staff member to help
documents.qr_title: Scan this code with your phone
documents.qr_spoken: Open the camera on your phone and point it at the square code on the screen. A page will open on your phone where you can take photographs of your papers.
documents.qr_step_1: Open the camera on your phone
documents.qr_step_2: Point it at the code on this screen
documents.qr_step_3: Take a photograph of each paper
documents.qr_expires_in: This code works for {minutes} more minutes
documents.qr_no_phone: I do not have a phone with a camera
documents.camera_hold_steady: Hold the paper flat and steady
documents.upload_processing: We are reading it. You do not need to wait.
documents.upload_needs_recapture: This photograph is not clear enough. Please take it again.
documents.upload_failed: This did not go through. Please try once more.
documents.no_need_to_wait: You do not need to wait for these to be read

review.title: Please check what we noted
review.title_spoken: Here is what I have noted from your answers. Please listen, and tell me if anything is wrong.
review.not_asked_emergency: Not asked — the nurse was called
review.you_did_not_know: You said you did not know

complete.title: Thank you, that is all
complete.body: Your information is ready for the doctor. Please wait to be called.
complete.body_spoken: Thank you. That is all we needed. Your information is now ready for the doctor. Please wait in the waiting area until your name is called.
complete.token_note: Please follow the hospital's usual waiting process
complete.next_step_1: The doctor will read what you told us
complete.next_step_2: The doctor will check it with you
complete.next_step_3: Nothing is final until the doctor confirms it
complete.finish_spoken: Touch the button to finish. The screen will then be cleared for the next person.
complete.clearing: Clearing the screen for the next person…

status.offline_body: You can continue. Your answers are saved here and will be sent when the connection returns.
status.offline_spoken: The internet connection is not working at the moment. Do not worry — you can carry on answering. Nothing will be lost.
status.reconnected: Connection restored. Your answers have been sent.
status.voice_degraded: Voice is slow right now — you can touch instead
status.session_timeout_body: This screen will be cleared soon so the next person can use it.
status.session_timeout_spoken: Are you still there? Touch the screen if you would like to continue.
status.get_help: Get help from a staff member

privacy.your_data_note: Your information is used only for your treatment at this hospital
privacy.no_aadhaar_note: We never ask for or store your Aadhaar number
privacy.screen_will_clear: This screen is cleared completely after you finish
privacy.ai_assists_only: A computer helps prepare your notes. Only the doctor decides.
